```yaml
name: Promote RC to Stable

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      rc_tag:
        description: 'RC Tag to promote (e.g., v3.0.0-rc5)'
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: write
  packages: write

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      stable_tag: ${{ steps.parse.outputs.stable_tag }}
      commit_sha: ${{ steps.get_sha.outputs.sha }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Parse RC tag
        id: parse
        run: |
          RC_TAG="${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}"
          # Remove leading 'v' if present for processing, then add back for stable tag
          CLEAN_TAG="${RC_TAG#v}"
          # Extract version part before -rc
          VERSION_PART="${CLEAN_TAG%%-rc*}"
          STABLE_TAG="v${VERSION_PART}"
          echo "stable_tag=${STABLE_TAG}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "Parsed stable tag: ${STABLE_TAG}"

      - name: Validate RC tag exists
        run: |
          RC_TAG="${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}"
          if ! git rev-parse -q --verify "refs/tags/${RC_TAG}" >/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::RC tag ${RC_TAG} does not exist in the repository."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "RC tag ${RC_TAG} exists."

      - name: Validate stable tag does not exist
        run: |
          STABLE_TAG="${{ steps.parse.outputs.stable_tag }}"
          if git rev-parse -q --verify "refs/tags/${STABLE_TAG}" >/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::Stable tag ${STABLE_TAG} already exists. Aborting to prevent overwriting."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Stable tag ${STABLE_TAG} does not exist. Safe to proceed."

      - name: Get Commit SHA
        id: get_sha
        run: |
          RC_TAG="${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}"
          SHA=$(git rev-list -n 1 "${RC_TAG}")
          echo "sha=${SHA}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  promote:
    needs: validate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Configure Git
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Create Stable Git Tag
        env:
          STABLE_TAG: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}
          COMMIT_SHA: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.commit_sha }}
          RC_TAG: ${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}
        run: |
          git tag -a "${STABLE_TAG}" "${COMMIT_SHA}" -m "Promote ${RC_TAG} to stable"
          git push origin "${STABLE_TAG}"

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Login to Docker Hub
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_PASSWORD }}

      - name: Retag Docker Images (beyla)
        env:
          RC_TAG: ${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}
          STABLE_TAG: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}
        run: |
          # Retag grafana/beyla
          docker buildx imagetools create \
            --tag grafana/beyla:${STABLE_TAG} \
            grafana/beyla:${RC_TAG}
          
          echo "Retagged grafana/beyla:${RC_TAG} -> grafana/beyla:${STABLE_TAG}"

      - name: Retag Docker Images (beyla-k8s-cache)
        env:
          RC_TAG: ${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}
          STABLE_TAG: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}
        run: |
          # Retag grafana/beyla-k8s-cache
          docker buildx imagetools create \
            --tag grafana/beyla-k8s-cache:${STABLE_TAG} \
            grafana/beyla-k8s-cache:${RC_TAG}
          
          echo "Retagged grafana/beyla-k8s-cache:${RC_TAG} -> grafana/beyla-k8s-cache:${STABLE_TAG}"

      - name: Download RC Release Assets
        id: download_assets
        uses: robinraju/release-downloader@v1.11
        with:
          repository: "grafana/beyla"
          tag: ${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}
          fileName: "*"
          out-file-path: "rc_assets"
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Create Stable GitHub Release
        id: create_release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}
          release_name: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}
          body: |
            ## Release Notes
            
            This is the stable release promoted from ${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}.
            
            ### Changes
            See the [RC Release Notes](${{ steps.download_assets.outputs.download_url }}) for detailed changes.
            
            ### Assets
            The following assets have been copied from the RC release:
            - Beyla binaries for various platforms
            - Checksums and signatures
            
            ### Manual Follow-up
            - [ ] Update Helm chart version
            - [ ] Update technical documentation links
          draft: false
          prerelease: false

      - name: Upload Assets to Stable Release
        env:
          STABLE_TAG: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}
          UPLOAD_URL: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          # List files in rc_assets directory
          ls -la rc_assets/
          
          # Upload each file
          for file in rc_assets/*; do
            if [ -f "$file" ]; then
              FILENAME=$(basename "$file")
              echo "Uploading $FILENAME..."
              
              # Extract the part before {?name,label}
              UPLOAD_URL_CLEAN="${UPLOAD_URL%%\{*}"
              
              curl -L \
                -X POST \
                -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
                -H "Authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_TOKEN" \
                -H "Content-Type: $(file -b --mime-type $file)" \
                --data-binary @"$file" \
                "${UPLOAD_URL_CLEAN}?name=${FILENAME}"
              
              echo "Uploaded $FILENAME"
            fi
          done

      - name: Add Workflow Summary
        env:
          RC_TAG: ${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}
          STABLE_TAG: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}
          RELEASE_URL: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.html_url }}
        run: |
          echo "## Promotion Complete" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "Successfully promoted **${RC_TAG}** to **${STABLE_TAG}**." >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "### Actions Taken" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- Created git tag: \`${STABLE_TAG}\`" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- Retagged Docker images:" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "  - \`grafana/beyla:${STABLE_TAG}\`" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "  - \`grafana/beyla-k8s-cache:${STABLE_TAG}\`" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- Created GitHub Release: [${STABLE_TAG}](${RELEASE_URL})" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- Copied binary assets from RC release" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "### Manual Follow-up Required" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- [ ] Update Helm chart version in \`grafana/helm-charts\`" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- [ ] Update technical documentation to point to stable version" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
```
